question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fatal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **Fatal **means causing death or leading to failure. (मृत्यु का कारण बनना या असफलता का कारण बनना)

 
 
• **Example**: *His injuries were fatal, and despite the efforts of the medical team, he could not be saved.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that option 5 should be a negative adjective to describe the blank.
 
• Therefore, 'fatal' is the best-fitted word for this sentence.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appropriate **means suitable or fitting for a particular purpose or situation. (किसी विशेष उद्देश्य या स्थिति के लिए उपयुक्त)
 
• **Beneficial **means advantageous or helpful. (लाभप्रद या सहायक)
 
• **Remedial **means intended to correct or improve something, especially a problem or deficiency. (किसी चीज़ को सही करने या सुधारने का इरादा, विशेषकर किसी समस्या या कमी को)
